definitions.ask: Should the sync run's final human line always name the synced day?
definitions.why: One uniform line keeps every toast self-contained with no second date rule.

choices.label: Every echo reads "synced <Ddd YYYY-MM-DD> · <HH:MM> · <account>", today included
Same-day syncs keep the short "synced <HH:MM>" echo; only other days name the day

definitions.ask: Should Tab on a RECENT single-run row open argument mode prefilled with that run's recorded args?
definitions.why: Editing the last run's args is the gesture Bryan reached for when Tab "did nothing".

choices.label: Recent rows with a catalog entry open argument mode with the recorded args ready to edit
Recent rows only show a footer hint on Tab; args stay reachable from entry and typed rows

definitions.ask: Should a real-Obsidian e2e drive an actual Tab keypress through the command sheet?
definitions.why: Handler logic is already unit-tested; only a real Obsidian run settles the reported symptom.

choices.label: CDP e2e in a scratch vault sends a trusted Tab and asserts argument mode renders
Only fake-DOM dispatch tests; cannot rule out an Obsidian-level routing failure
